scope: Followup development after primary Full evaluation was opened. No claim of a new unopened Full test.

model.output: scalar nodal A; exact P1 element curl gives B
model.graph: same six disconnected stationary homogenized slots and original FE adjacency as primary study
model.gauge: independent area-weighted nodal A mean removed per slot
model.loss: area-weighted element vector-B MSE normalized by training B RMS plus 0.1 times gauge-centered nodal-A MSE normalized by training A RMS
model.training_target: original Elmer nodal A and its element B; Motor-CAD element-averaged A is not imported

training.phase_monitor: index modulo8 ==7; auxiliary known-source monitor, not a globally unopened test
training.phase_sanity: first20 updates discarded; no weights reused
training.schedule: Adam lr0.001 for1800updates; new Adam at1801 with cosine0.0003 to0.00001 for16200updates, matching primary two-stage optimization
training.checkpoint: fixed final update, no best-stage/seed selection

downstream.head: same Gaussian ridge log Full/Hybrid residual
downstream.selection: same9 hyperparameters using grouped inner CV on calibration63 only
downstream.reported: calibration group-CV and MS field monitor only; no HalfSC or primary Full evaluation reranking
downstream.input_features: same normalized scalar features and96 pooled latent features

bounds.stop: UTC deadline and owned STOP checked each update; outer supervisor verifies process creation time and terminates only owned process tree

reused_idea: EveryMotor exact P1 nodal-A to element-B supervision; actual E1 checkpoint representation must be checked separately, filename/trainer name does not establish it.
formal_physical_qualification: UNKNOWN; auxiliary MS accuracy is not Full AC accuracy
